national_news.title: Supreme Court Rules Out Total Ban on Firecrackers Ahead of Diwali
bullets: A Supreme Court bench comprising Justices MM Sundresh and PB Varale ruled out a complete ban on firecrackers ahead of Diwali, favoring a balanced approach.
The court indicated it will permit specific firecrackers with designated time limits, balancing religious sentiments with air pollution concerns.
The bench granted time till October 15 to the Additional Solicitor General to place on record the Central Pollution Control Board’s report on barium-based firecrackers.

national_news.title: Indian Pilot Captain Smit Machchhar Hailed for Foiling Hijack Attempt
bullets: Indian Captain Smit Machchhar was hailed globally after subduing an attacking Omani co-pilot who attempted to crash a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
Despite serious injuries, Captain Machchhar fought back, allowing passengers and crew to secure the cockpit and land safely at Tabuk Regional Airport, Saudi Arabia.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other global leaders praised the captain's extraordinary bravery and unwavering resolve in saving 174 lives.

national_news.title: KVIC Chairman Hails Lijjat Papad Women Artisans under Vocal for Local Vision
bullets: KVIC Chairman Manoj Goyal addressed women artisans of Shri Mahila Griha Udyog Lijjat Papad in Mumbai, highlighting its alignment with 'Vocal for Local' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat'.
Lijjat Papad, established on March 15, 1959, with 7 women and Rs. 80, was recognized as a Village Industry by KVIC in 1966 and currently employs over 45,000 women across 83 branches in 16 states.
The KVIC Chairman noted that Khadi and Village Industries production has reached approximately ₹1.25 lakh crore, with sales touching ₹1.87 lakh crore.

national_news.title: CCEA Approves Rabi MSP Hike for 2027-28, PM-DHARA Scheme, and Delhi ITMS Project
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved an increase in Minimum Support Prices (MSPs) for all mandated Rabi crops for Marketing Season 2027-28, with safflower seeing the highest absolute increase of ₹675 per quintal.

The Cabinet approved the PM-DHARA (PM-Developing Harmonized and Accelerated Renewable-energy Access) Scheme to strengthen intra-state transmission for evacuating up to 135 GW of renewable energy and deploying 50 GWh of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
The CCEA sanctioned ₹1,789 crore for Delhi Police to implement the Intelligent Traffic Management System (ITMS) project across 42 identified corridors over 24 months.

national_news.title: Severe Flood Situation in North Bihar Following Heavy Rainfall in Nepal
bullets: Continuous rainfall in Nepal's Gandak basin and North Bihar caused record water level rises in the Gandak, Bagmati, and Kosi rivers.
Embankments breached in multiple locations including West Champaran, East Champaran (Areraj), and Gopalganj, affecting over 200 villages.
Water Resources Department deployed engineering teams and relief operations are underway across affected districts like Muzaffarpur, Vaishali, and Saran.

national_news.title: Digital India BHASHINI and CAG Launch AI-enabled Translation Tool 'CAG-BHASHINI Anuvaad'
bullets: The Digital India BHASHINI Division and CAG launched 'CAG-BHASHINI Anuvaad', an AI-enabled document translation solution for official CAG reports.
Developed under Digital India Corporation, the tool supports consistent terminology, contextual translation, data sovereignty, and secure institutional workflows.
BHASHINI currently supports 36 Indian text languages, 23 Indian voice languages, and 35 international languages for public-service use cases.

national_news.title: ACC Approves Re-employment of Dhirendra Ojha as PIB Principal DG
bullets: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) approved the one-year re-employment of senior Indian Information Service (IIS) officer Dhirendra Ojha as Principal Director General of the Press Information Bureau (PIB).
His contract tenure is effective from October 1, 2026, to September 30, 2027, keeping Recruitment Rules in abeyance.
The ACC also cleared the temporary upgradation of a Director General level post to Principal Director General for senior officer Pragya Paliwal Gaur.

national_news.title: 8th PM Mementos e-Auction Showcases West Bengal's Cultural Heritage
bullets: The 8th edition of the PM Mementos e-Auction features 109 mementos representing the artistic, cultural, and religious heritage of West Bengal.
The curated collection highlights traditional crafts including Sholapith artwork, Dhokra craftsmanship, Bankura horses, and terracotta structures like the Rasmancha monument in Bishnupur.
It also includes items associated with notable personalities like Rabindranath Tagore, Swami Vivekananda, and Satyajit Ray.

national_news.title: Ministry of Power Notifies New CAFE Norms for 2027-32
bullets: The Ministry of Power notified new Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) norms for passenger vehicles, effective from April 1, 2027, to March 31, 2032.
The framework aims for a 16.7% improvement in average fuel efficiency, tightening fuel consumption criteria from 3.996 litres per 100 km in 2027-28 to 3.3273 litres per 100 km in 2031-32.
Electric vehicles, hybrids, and alternative-fuel vehicles will receive compliance incentives and 'super credits' under fleet-average calculations.

national_news.title: 65th National Exhibition of Art Organised by Lalit Kala Akademi
bullets: Union Minister of Culture and Tourism Gajendra Singh Shekhawat felicitated 20 award-winning artists at the 65th National Exhibition of Art in New Delhi.
The event was organised by the Lalit Kala Akademi at Rabindra Bhawan, receiving over 6,000 entries from which 270 artists were selected.
A monograph on eminent modern Indian painter Abdul Aziz Raiba, edited by Ram Gopal Khadilkar, was also released during the occasion.

national_news.title: India's Semiconductor Mission: Advancing Towards 2 nm Chip Technology
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw inaugurated ARM's new semiconductor design office in Bengaluru focusing on next-generation 2 nanometre chip technology.
Total approved projects under the India Semiconductor Mission stand at ten across six states with cumulative investments of Rs 1.6 lakh crore and an outlay of Rs 76,000 crore.
Under the Design Linked Incentive (DLI) Scheme, 23 chip design projects have been sanctioned and 72 companies now use advanced design tools.

bihar_news.title: SECI Issues Tender for 60 MW Solar Project in Gaya, Bihar
bullets: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has issued an EPC tender to develop a 60 MW inter-state transmission system (ISTS)-connected solar project in Gaya, Bihar.
The project will be located at Habibpur, Dariaura, and adjacent to the Dobhi-Patna Road, with power evacuation through a 132 kV bay at the PGCIL substation in Chandauti.
The solar power plant is designed for a lifespan of 25 years, with a comprehensive operation and maintenance (O&M) period of five years.

bihar_news.title: Gandak River Embankments Breach in Gopalganj and Saran Districts of Bihar
bullets: Embankments along the Gandak River breached at two locations in Gopalganj and Saran districts due to heavy water discharge originating from catchment areas in Nepal.
A six-metre section of the Zamindari Bund in Gopalganj's Baikunthpur block and an eight-metre section of the right Saran embankment in Maker block gave way.
The Valmikinagar Barrage recorded a peak discharge of about 5.43 lakh cusecs, placing districts like West Champaran, Gopalganj, and Saran on high flood alert.
